verdict.rationale: The Florida Department of Revenue is a service provider, not an AI agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence documents one. References to 'agents' concern tax agents filing for clients, not AI agents. The available interfaces (eFile web apps, XML packages, batch enrollment files) are not MCP, and the probes found no llms.txt or markdown docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
